tour_step1_body: This is your home health and your companion. Care for things on time — the score grows and your pet cheers up.
tour_step2_body: One button welcomes something new home. Ready-made templates cover everything from toothbrushes to water filters.
tour_step3_body: The green Done button finishes the job and computes the next date itself. The little clock postpones the reminder.
tour_step3_empty_body: Things needing care will appear here. Press Add a thing — and let's begin.
tour_step4_body: Things live in rooms: bathroom, kitchen, bedroom. Peek in here to find anything fast.
tour_step5_body: Close the window freely: reminders arrive on their own. Quick actions live in the tray menu, autostart in Settings.
